name: wds_imagenet_sketch
description: A sketch-style variant drawn from ImageNet intended to evaluate model robustness to large domain/style shift (photo -> sketch). It is typically used to assess image classification and zero-shot transfer performance of vision and multimodal models. The benchmark highlights how models trained on photographic ImageNet degrade on sketch-style inputs and is commonly used in robustness and CLIP evaluations.
reputation: Moderately used as a domain-shift / robustness testset (commonly referenced in CLIP and robustness studies), but less central than photographic ImageNet.
